title: Fledging-minus-egg drought response contrasts were negative in five of six bird study samples in a 2024 release
abstract: We compared fledging and egg-output drought responses within study, species and drought category in a 2024 public bird release. Nine matched cells gave six study contrasts. Five were negative and one was positive. Two normal-reference intervals were below zero after six-test correction, using the largest standard errors allowed by all within-study correlations. The six-study sign reference test was uncertain (P = 0.219). A successful-pair endpoint changed the Spanish contrast sign. Checks against two primary papers exposed limits of released endpoint labels. Different nests, denominators, standard deviations and selected studies prevent a common recruitment or causal drought claim. Code, source hashes, aggregate results, checks and a figure are included. Raw source data stay external.

display.caption: Fledging-minus-egg standardized responses in six study samples. Bars use maximum sampling SD under arbitrary within-study covariance and normal-reference six-test correction. Different endpoint samples and denominators limit biological interpretation.
